pages.quiz:
AGRICULTURE — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #2
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: AGRICULTURE
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Conserving Wild Animals? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Conserving Wild Animals.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Conserving Wild Animals.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Conserving Wild Animals.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Conserving Wild Animals.

2. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Water Conservation? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Water Conservation.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Water Conservation.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Water Conservation.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Water Conservation.

3. In a food chain, green plants are usually: (1 mark)
   A. Tertiary consumers
   B. Decomposers only
   C. Producers
   D. Primary consumers only

4. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Uses of Domestic Animals? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Uses of Domestic Animals.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Uses of Domestic Animals.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Uses of Domestic Animals.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Uses of Domestic Animals.

5. An element is: (1 mark)
   A. A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means
   B. Any white crystal used in cooking
   C. A mixture of two liquids
   D. Any substance that conducts electricity

6. Soil erosion is reduced by: (1 mark)
   A. Overgrazing continuously
   B. Removing all vegetation
   C. Planting cover crops and terracing slopes
   D. Burning crop residue every week

7. The SI unit of force is the: (1 mark)
   A. joule (J)
   B. newton (N)
   C. pascal (Pa)
   D. watt (W)

8. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Cooking Food food frying food? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Cooking Food food frying food.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Cooking Food food frying food.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Cooking Food food frying food.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Cooking Food food frying food.

9. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Making Tacking Stitches? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Making Tacking Stitches.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Making Tacking Stitches.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Making Tacking Stitches.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Making Tacking Stitches.

10. Diffusion is best described as: (1 mark)
   A. A chemical reaction forming ash
   B. Net movement of particles from high to low concentration
   C. Movement of water only across a membrane
   D. Heating until a solid melts

11. A compound differs from a mixture because: (1 mark)
   A. Mixtures cannot exist in Kenya
   B. Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio
   C. A mixture always has a fixed melting point
   D. A compound can be separated by filtering only

12. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Growing Fruits? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Growing Fruits.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Growing Fruits.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Growing Fruits.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Growing Fruits.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Growing Fruits and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Uses of Domestic Animals and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Balanced Meal and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Cooking Food food frying food and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
pages.answers:
MARKING SCHEME
====

1. C — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Conserving Wild Animals.

2. D — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Water Conservation.

3. C — Producers

4. A — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Uses of Domestic Animals.

5. A — A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means

6. C — Planting cover crops and terracing slopes

7. B — newton (N)

8. B — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Cooking Food food frying food.

9. C — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Making Tacking Stitches.

10. B — Net movement of particles from high to low concentration

11. B — Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio

12. D — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Growing Fruits.

13. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Growing Fruits; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

16. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Cooking Food food frying food; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.
